notes: This fixture is the single source of truth for both allowlists below: the ONLY place either may be edited. hooks/sessionstart-tool-enum.mjs loads it at runtime and never hardcodes an entry inline -- see src/policy/tools/central-classification.ts's header comment for the full disclosure.

There is no expiry date and no test that pins this file's contents: entries apply until removed, and the PR diff of this file is the review. Adding a name to either list silently suppresses that name's SUR-03 halt at the next SessionStart. Standing exception recorded in docs/adr/ (project-tier ADR) and docs/decisions.md's 2026-09-19 row.

centralLayer.tools[].class is rule data since S7 (GitHub Issue #93): the tool-class normalizer turns an entry's class into a marker verb a central or project rule can match, for MCP tool calls whose server name consists solely of [A-Za-z0-9-]. The kernel-gate hook that runs it is built but NOT WIRED and no shipped rule matches a class yet (baseline allow content is an activation precondition), so today a class drives no live enforcement decision. Classifying a tool here also removes it from SUR-03's unclassified/halt set.

knownConnectors is a pure display-name string match against ~/.claude.json's claudeAiMcpEverConnected array -- spoofable in principle, NOT a real security control (GitHub Issue #90). A connector renamed, or a new connector named identically to an entry, defeats it completely. It stands only on the human's explicit acceptance of that risk, until an out-of-repo classification source ships (Issue #224).
